name: Ambient Clinical Documentation Assistant
description: Records doctor-patient consultations in outpatient clinics of a fictional private hospital and drafts the clinical note (history, examination, plan) in the electronic medical record. The physician must review, edit and sign every note; the assistant does not diagnose or prescribe.
documentation:
DATA: audio of consultations, transcripts and draft notes containing health information.
HOSTING: speech and language models hosted in a cloud region inside Saudi Arabia; DPA signed; audio deleted after 7 days.
OVERSIGHT: notes are drafts until the physician signs; physicians trained on reviewing AI drafts.
ACCURACY: pilot on 200 visits - 4% of drafts contained a clinically significant error that physicians caught and corrected.
GAPS: patient consent is verbal and not recorded in the EMR; no specific evaluation for Arabic dialect consultations or paediatric visits; no process yet for patients to opt out in advance; ongoing monitoring of error rate after the pilot is not defined.
SECURITY: encryption at rest and in transit; access logged.
